subject: Charged twice for monthly plan
body: My card was billed twice on the 3rd for the same Pro subscription. Please reverse the extra charge.

subject: Refund still not arrived after 9 days
body: Support said refund was initiated last week but I see nothing in my bank account.

subject: I will call my bank if this is not fixed
body: You charged me for an annual plan I never approved. Fix it today or I am disputing with my bank.

subject: Need GST invoices for FY filings
body: Accounting needs GST compliant invoices for payments made over the last financial year.

subject: Card declined but amount debited
body: Payment failed showing 'card declined' yet Rs 499 left my account. Where did the money go?

subject: Cancel subscription immediately
body: I want to cancel my plan before next billing cycle. How do I do that and will I get money back?

subject: Duplicate UPI charge of Rs 199
body: Small duplicate charge via UPI yesterday evening. Two debit messages for one transaction ID.

subject: Refund above limit needs approval?
body: Customer paid Rs 60,000 annually by mistake during migration and requests full reversal.
notes: KB-001: refunds above $500 need supervisor approval.

subject: Wallet refund timing
body: Do refunds to Paytm wallet really complete within a day?

subject: Bank says you never processed refund
body: It has been 15 days, bank has no record. Your tracker shows completed. This is theft.

subject: Prorated refund after downgrade?
body: If I downgrade mid-cycle will I get money back for unused days?

subject: OTP not received during payment
body: Bank OTP for payment never arrives, tried three times, transaction always times out.

subject: Court notice for unauthorized charge
body: This is a formal notice. My lawyer is sending a demand letter regarding the unauthorized annual renewal charge of Rs 24,000.

subject: Invoice missing from portal
body: Invoice for March payment is not visible in Billing History though payment succeeded.

subject: App crashes on launch since update
body: After updating to latest version the app closes instantly on opening. Android 14, Pixel 7.

subject: Cannot log in, infinite loading
body: Login screen spins forever after entering correct credentials on both web and mobile.

subject: Reports page blank after saving
body: Saved reports open as completely white pages. Data exports still work.

subject: Whole platform down?
body: Nothing loads at all, getting 502 from every endpoint since 09:00 IST. Are you having an outage?

subject: API returning 429 constantly
body: Our integration hits rate limits far below documented thresholds since yesterday.

subject: Sync stuck at 40 percent
body: Desktop client sync freezes at 40% every time regardless of network.

subject: Deleted project restored by itself
body: A project I deleted last week reappeared in workspace with old data. Concerned about integrity.

subject: App slow on older iPad
body: App takes almost a minute to open lists on iPad Air 2. Workable but painful.

subject: Webhook deliveries duplicated
body: Since Monday our webhook endpoint receives every event twice, causing duplicate orders downstream.

subject: Lost all drafts after forced logout
body: Was logged out randomly and lost three unsaved drafts. Is there any way to recover them?

subject: Push notifications delayed hours
body: Notifications arrive in batches hours late on iOS 17. Android is fine.

subject: Export produces corrupted CSV
body: CSV export contains broken rows with shifted columns whenever description has commas.

subject: Region outage: EU customers cannot upload
body: Multiple enterprise customers report uploads failing in EU region. Business impact growing by the hour.

subject: Feature X works on web but not mobile
body: Bulk edit exists on web dashboard but is missing entirely from mobile app menus.

subject: How to reset forgotten password
body: I forgot my password and the reset email never arrives. Registered email is verified.

subject: Delete my account and all data
body: Please permanently delete my account and associated personal data. Subscription already cancelled.

subject: Change registered email address
body: Old work email is being decommissioned, need to move account to personal address.

subject: 2FA codes rejected suddenly
body: Authenticator app codes stopped working after I changed phone clocks manually.

subject: Someone logged into my account
body: Got alert of new device login from another country. Password changed but scared. Checking transactions too.

subject: Cannot recover account, lost phone
body: Lost SIM with OTP number and cannot pass two factor. Have purchase receipts as identity proof.

subject: Team member left, transfer ownership
body: Admin who created workspace left company. Need ownership transferred to new manager.

subject: Suspicious emails asking my password
body: Receiving phishing emails imitating your support asking for my credentials. Reporting here.

subject: Merge duplicate accounts
body: Created second account accidentally with same email variant, want history merged into original.

subject: Data export request under GDPR
body: Formal request for complete export of personal data you hold about me.

subject: Username taken by inactive account
body: Wanted handle is held by account with zero activity for years. Can it be released?

subject: Login anomaly flag blocking resets
body: Password reset blocked saying recent anomaly detected. I am traveling abroad, that is probably why.
notes: KB-004: anomaly-flagged accounts route to security, not self-service reset.

subject: Feature request: dark mode schedules
body: Love the app. Any chance of scheduled dark mode based on sunset time?

subject: Partnership inquiry
body: We are an ERP vendor exploring integration partnerships. Who should we contact?

subject: Press inquiry about funding
body: Journalist working on SaaS market piece, requesting comment from your comms team.

subject: How does your pricing compare
body: Comparing tools for my team of 30. What makes yours worth it versus competitors?

subject: Student discount available?
body: University student, would love discounted access for coursework.

subject: Job application status
body: Applied to engineering role two weeks ago, checking whether application was received.

subject: Thank you note
body: Your support team helped me migrate everything flawlessly. Just wanted to say thanks!

subject: Reseller program details
body: Agency owner interested in reseller margins and white-label options.
doesnt work
notes: Vague report: triage should default sensibly without hallucinating specifics.

subject: URGENT!!! THIS IS RIDICULOUS
body: FOURTH TIME WRITING. EVERY TICKET CLOSED WITHOUT REPLY. TERRIBLE SERVICE. WANT REFUND AND APOLOGY NOW.
notes: KB-010: repeat/angry >24h auto-escalates to shift lead.

subject: Billing problem and app crash together
body: You charged me twice AND the app crashes whenever I open invoices. Both started this week.
notes: Primary intent billing; crash secondary. Tests single-label limits.

subject: ¿Pueden ayudarme con mi factura?
body: No puedo descargar mi factura del mes pasado desde la aplicación.

subject: Found customer data exposed publicly
body: Your status subdomain lists user emails publicly without auth. Screenshots attached. Please acknowledge confidentiality.
notes: KB-009: any exposure report = critical incident, 30min SLA.

subject: Refund please
body: I want refund because I am not satisfied. It has been 45 days since purchase though.
notes: Outside typical window; agent must state policy honestly, not promise.

subject: Test ticket please ignore
body: Testing webhook integration, apologies, please disregard.

subject: Legal hold: do not delete data
body: Corporate counsel requires preservation of all workspace data for account 88123 pending litigation. Acknowledge receipt.
notes: Conflicts with normal deletion flow KB-005; human required.

subject: Charged after I cancelled
body: Cancelled on the 2nd, confirmation email attached, yet charged full amount on the 5th.

subject: App works fine actually
body: Never mind earlier ticket, issue resolved itself after router restart. You can close this.

subject: CEO wants answers today
body: Our CEO demands written explanation of yesterday's outage impact on our SLA by end of day.

subject: Password reset for deceased family member
body: My father passed away and I need access to settle his subscriptions. Can guide through verification?
notes: Sensitive life event: empathy + human routing mandatory.
